descriptions.text: Hobgoblin Disco Ball. Type: Magically-infused Deflagrating Tossable. Effect: It's a real trip. Status: 25. Unstable. Molly not included. Take a Hobgoblin smoke curtain, soak it in an invisibility potion, and what do you get? You get a party, that's what you get! Produces heavy, multi-hued billows of smoke that are both photosensitive and frequency responsive. And in case you don't know what that means, just set one off and find out. The smoke will conceal all movement within, and the plumes will bounce to the beat. Warning: Unlike a regular smoke curtain, the caster of this tossable is not immune to its effects. In other words, you'll be just as blind as the monsters. …

beats.headline: Rainbow in the crafting room
beats.text: Carl has been infusing smoke curtains since he read about the idea in the cookbook, mostly into duds. This one he stole the recipe for and has to pretend he stumbled on: a red smoke curtain soaked in an invisibility potion, now shining with a multi-coloured opalescence. His Infusion skill rises to level 3. Robot Donut, watching from the table, hops up and down to cheer, the ball goes flying to the floor, and Carl steps back right onto it. Rainbow smoke fills the room, Mordecai curses over his alchemy table, and it leaves a sandy, technicolor residue on everything. The common area smells of burnt cotton candy.

beats.headline: The dust did the job
beats.text: Administrator Loita is dead, killed when the Donut toy that followed her off the couch exploded, and Orren lays out how. The disco ball's residue slowly ate at the panel on the back of the toy's head, the moisture of the admin's rebreather ran it along the edges, and the jump dislodged the panel and set off the self-destruct. One of the most brilliant assassinations he has ever seen a crawler execute, he says. Carl knows better. He only wanted the dust all over the toy so nobody would want it in the studio, and had not realised the dust was already doing the job for him.

beats.headline: From the lower wing
beats.text: Quan Ch hangs in the air ahead with his shield still up. Carl locks the biplane's trajectory, climbs out onto the lower wing beside the starboard propeller, and tells Donut to switch her glasses to heat. He loads the hobgoblin disco ball into the xistera and throws, missing the propeller by inches. It bursts over Quan's chest anyway, knocking him back, its sticky sand clinging to his shield like mud. As they pass, Donut empties the gun and a double magic missile into the rainbow cloud. Carl's fused hob-lobber goes off twenty feet short, close enough, and the pulsing smoke plummets out of the sky with its sticky remnants following Quan down like a comet.

beats.headline: Against the queen's lightning
beats.text: Imogen's health is almost gone, a black nimbus round her and her hands crackling red: a lightning attack. Britney is screaming on the ground, and Louis and Firas lie unconscious side by side. Carl has had no time to reinstall the xistera, so he throws a hobgoblin disco ball by hand, shouting at Britney about her jacket. It splatters multi-coloured goo across the side of Imogen's head, and she barely notices. Her lightning comes out as a single bolt, drawn into the clump of spreading butterflies. It is not what Carl intended, but it works too.

beats.headline: Out of the truck's roof
beats.text: Racing along an apartment ceiling to make sure Imani and Elle reach their gate, Carl climbs out of his seat with Sticky Feet on and hurls Biscuit Packs at the beetles. One crashes into the truck's electrified shield and comes back for more, and he drops a hobgoblin disco ball out of the hole in the roof. It goes off as it falls, flashing colourful lights and thick smoke everywhere. Elle reports they have already hit the gate. Then the truck drops from the ceiling into the smoke-filled living room.
